environment.description: Go microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS ALB with path-based routing. The ALB forwards all traffic matching /api/v1/* to the target group. No request body inspection or schema validation is configured. Authentication is handled by a sidecar that sets X-Authenticated-User-ID header. The service is exposed internally within the VPC to other microservices and a React frontend.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with path-based routing only
config.network: VPC internal, accessible from frontend and other services
config.auth: Sidecar envoy proxy sets X-Authenticated-User-ID after JWT validation
